s.headline: Ranked Exploit Fixed in Apex Legends Update
top_changes: Removed exploit for entering Ranked matches without paying entry costs
s.meta_impact: This fix prevents unfair Ranked entries, restoring integrity to the mode. All players must now pay proper costs to compete. It promotes fairer matchmaking and competition overall.

s.headline: New Agent Hush, Warden Buffs, Clove Nerfs
top_changes: New Agent Hush added with telekinesis abilities
Warden recoil and spread improved
Clove movement speed and kill rewards adjusted
Haste and Snapshot buff terms standardized
Tooltip and UI clarity updates across agents
buffs: Warden: pitch recoil smoothed, 2nd/3rd bullet error reduced
Brimstone/Clove/Miks/Neon/Waylay: Haste buff now shown with timer
All Agents: updated ability descriptions and tooltips for clarity
nerfs: Clove: Not Dead Yet kill now grants ult point and signature refresh to killer
s.meta_impact: Hush introduces new telekinesis utility that could disrupt team fights and positioning. Warden becomes more viable at its price point with better handling. Clove's adjustments reduce her mobility edge and reward opponents for punishing her ultimate.

s.headline: Patch 26.21: Caitlyn/Jinx/Lee nerfs, Varus fix, item tweaks
top_changes: Caitlyn and Jinx nerfed for high presence
Lee Sin and Rammus power reduced
Varus Q bug fixed with compensation buffs
Gluttonous Greaves and Hubris nerfed for ranged
Buffs to Azir, Orianna, Ryze, Sion, Nunu
buffs: Azir: Mana Growth 40 to 50 per level
Darius: Q cooldown reduced at rank 5
Miss Fortune: E and R damage increased
Nunu & Willump: R max damage increased
Ryze: Q flux and MS improved, W AP ratio up
Sion: Health growth increased, R channel damage up
nerfs: Caitlyn: Passive headshot damage down, Q base adjusted
Jinx: AD growth and base health reduced
Lee Sin: W cooldown to 8s, R damage reduced
Nidalee: W damage and E AS reduced
Tristana: Q early attack speed reduced
Viktor: MS to 330, Q shield reduced
s.meta_impact: Nerfs to dominant marksmen and junglers like Caitlyn, Jinx, Lee Sin, and Rammus should open up the meta for other picks. Mages like Azir, Orianna, and Ryze gain breathing room while item changes curb ranged abuse of Greaves and Hubris. Expect shifts toward more varied bot and jungle compositions.

s.headline: Fortnitemares & Override: New Horrors, Sprites, FNAF Bosses
top_changes: New Fortnitemares Islands and Safety in Numbers Quest
Override mode with Sonic, Tetris, Pac-Man inspired areas
Cursed cartridge corrupts BR with new weapons and bosses
Five Nights at Freddy's animatronic bosses at Pizza Parlor
New collectible Sprites with powers; Ranked with abilities off
s.meta_impact: New bosses and mechanics from FNAF and cursed cartridge add horror elements to Battle Royale fights. Sprites introduce collectible powers outside Ranked, shifting strategy toward extraction and leveling. Overrides and themed areas expand exploration and rule-breaking gameplay.
